brief: Older than 1970: the dark ride type has no newer boardwalk example. A two-storey dark-ride building whose front is a giant painted scene -- a grinning cat, a crooked roof, jagged orange letters -- and the car track in and out of it. 4 photos. Over the water: its foundations are the pier deck's pile bents, 10 m below the bed.
label: Amusement Pier
